weather.source: User styling brief and approved editorial concept; not live weather data.
assumptions: Light rain and daytime continue the approved editorial setting.
Actual air temperature and measured wind speed were not provided.

approval.evidence: User approved all five casual rain editorials and requested individual product images plus English, German and Korean HOW TO WEAR copy.

mappingNote: casual is an asset collection label; the current app supports run/street/minimal. Decide app style before integration; do not silently map to street.

deck.en: Navy quilting, ecru knit and a beanie held against the breeze.
deck.de: Marineblaue Steppung, ecrufarbener Strick und eine Mütze gegen den Wind.
deck.ko: 네이비 퀼팅에 에크루 니트, 바람에 날아갈 비니를 잡는 순간.

intro.en: Layer the ecru half-zip knit under the navy quilted jacket and zip the neckline high when the breeze picks up. Straight indigo jeans keep the shape easy, while warm socks bridge the gap to brown Chelsea boots. The beanie covers the ears and the small crossbody keeps both hands free.
intro.de: Trage den ecrufarbenen Troyer unter der marineblauen Steppjacke und ziehe den Kragen bei Wind hoch. Gerade Indigojeans halten die Silhouette entspannt; warme Socken schließen die Lücke zu den braunen Chelsea-Boots. Die Mütze bedeckt die Ohren, die kleine Crossbody lässt die Hände frei.
intro.ko: 네이비 퀼팅 재킷 안에 에크루 하프집 니트를 입고, 바람이 불면 지퍼를 올려 목을 감싸 주세요. 인디고 스트레이트 진으로 편안한 선을 만들고, 따뜻한 양말을 브라운 첼시 부츠까지 이어 주세요. 비니는 귀를 덮고 작은 크로스보디 백은 두 손을 가볍게 해줍니다.

tip.en: Keep the half-zip high outdoors and lower it indoors to adjust the warmth.
tip.de: Draußen den Troyer hoch schließen, drinnen den Reißverschluss für weniger Wärme öffnen.
tip.ko: 밖에서는 하프집을 올리고 실내에서는 내려서 따뜻함을 조절해 주세요.

note.en: Layer over a thick knit with room to move; choose verified rain protection for actual use.
